#Read expression counts for 4 tissues 
```{r}
expression_4_tissues <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/expression_counts/counts.genes_and_SVs.bed", header = T)
```
Clean up dataset
```{r}
#Exclude pollen samples
#expression_3_tissues <- dplyr::select(expression_4_tissues, -starts_with("P."))
#Exclude MT genes
expression_3_tissues <- expression_4_tissues[!grepl("^ATM", expression_4_tissues$gene), ]
#Exclude CP genes
expression_3_tissues <- expression_3_tissues[!grepl("^ATC", expression_3_tissues$gene), ]
```

```{r}
#Log2 dataset
expression_3_tissues_log2 <- expression_3_tissues  # First, create a copy of the original dataframe.
# Apply log2 transformation to all columns except the first one
#Add pseudocount
pseudocount <- 1
expression_3_tissues_log2 <- expression_3_tissues  # Create a copy of the dataframe
# Apply log2 transformation to all columns except the first one, adding a pseudocount to avoid -Inf
expression_3_tissues_log2[-1] <- lapply(expression_3_tissues[-1], function(x) log2(x + pseudocount))
```

Intersect with pericentromeric and arm gene defenition 
```{r}
#Read genes with location 
genes_tair10_with_location <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/TAIR10_GFF3_genes.gff") %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_tair10_with_location$gene_id <- gsub(";.*", "",genes_tair10_with_location$V9)
genes_tair10_with_location$gene_id <- gsub("ID=", "", genes_tair10_with_location$gene_id)
genes_tair10_with_location <- genes_tair10_with_location %>% select(V4, V5, gene_id)

colnames(genes_tair10_with_location) <- c("START", "STOP", "ATH")
genes_tair10_with_location$CHR <- as.numeric(sub("AT", "", sub("G.*", "", genes_tair10_with_location$ATH)))

filter_chromosome <- function(chromosome, boundary1, boundary2) {
  arms <- genes_tair10_with_location[genes_tair10_with_location$CHR == chromosome & (genes_tair10_with_location$START < boundary1 - 4000000 | genes_tair10_with_location$START > boundary2 + 4000000),]
  pericentromeric <- genes_tair10_with_location[genes_tair10_with_location$CHR == chromosome & genes_tair10_with_location$START > boundary1 - 4000000 & genes_tair10_with_location$START < boundary2 + 4000000,]
  arms$region <- 'arms'
  pericentromeric$region <- 'pericentromeric'
  chr_df <- rbind(pericentromeric, arms)
  chr_df$Chr <- chromosome
  return(chr_df)
}

chromosome_boundaries <- list(
  "1" = c(14841109, 17559778),
  "2" = c(3823791, 6045243),
  "3" = c(13597187, 15733925),
  "4" = c(4203901, 6977949),
  "5" = c(11784130, 14551809)
)

chromosomes_with_location <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(chromosome_boundaries), function(chromosome) {
  filter_chromosome(chromosome, chromosome_boundaries[[chromosome]][1], chromosome_boundaries[[chromosome]][2])
}))
```
Map  genes expression to have a location

expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location <- dplyr::inner_join(chromosomes_with_location,expression_3_tissues_log2, by=c("ATH"="gene"))

```{r}
# Example to reshape the data to long format
df_long <- pivot_longer(expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location, cols = -c(CHR, region, Chr,START), 
                        names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression")

# Extract tissue type from sample names
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(tissue = case_when(
    grepl("^F\\.", sample) ~ "F",
    grepl("^P\\.", sample) ~ "P",
    grepl("^R\\.", sample) ~ "R",
    grepl("^S\\.", sample) ~ "S",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"  # Just in case there are unexpected prefixes
  ))

# Optional: Clean up sample names if necessary (e.g., removing batch info)
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", sample))

```

    TRUE          ~ 'NS'  # NS indicates not significant
  ),

## Lyrata expression visualization
```{r}
expression <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/expression_alyrata/Fcounts_old_annot_paired_end.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
centromeres_alyrata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz_2023.txt", header=T)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
expression <- expression %>%
  # Fix scaffold → Chr
  mutate(Chr = gsub("scaffold_", "Chr", Chr)) %>%
  # Filter to Chr1-Chr8
  filter(Chr %in% paste0("Chr", 1:8)) %>%
  # Collapse centromere boundaries and join
  left_join(
    centromeres_alyrata %>%
      group_by(Chr) %>%
      summarise(cent_start = min(centr_start), cent_end = max(centr_end)) %>%
      ungroup(),
    by = "Chr"
  ) %>%
  # Compute midpoint and distance
  mutate(
    midpoint           = (Start + End) / 2,
    dist_to_centromere = pmax(0, pmax(cent_start - midpoint, midpoint - cent_end))
  )

expression <- expression %>%
  filter(Chr %in% paste0("Chr", 1:8))
```

```{r}
## Normilize expression matrix
# Extract count columns
count_cols <- grep("\\.bam$", colnames(expression), value = TRUE)

# Compute TPM
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(expression[, count_cols])
rpk <- counts_matrix / (expression$Length / 1000)
tpm_matrix <- t(t(rpk) / colSums(rpk) * 1e6)

# Build clean TPM matrix with gene IDs + genomic info
tpm_df <- data.frame(
  Geneid     = expression$Geneid,
  Chr        = expression$Chr,
  Start      = expression$Start,
  End        = expression$End,
  cent_start = expression$cent_start,
  cent_end   = expression$cent_end,
  tpm_matrix
)
```


```{r}
tpm_long <- tpm_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = ends_with(".bam"),
    names_to  = "sample",
    values_to = "TPM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    site     = case_when(
      grepl("LowSite",  sample) ~ "LowSite",
      grepl("HighSite", sample) ~ "HighSite",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    midpoint           = (Start + End) / 2,
    dist_to_centromere = pmax(0, pmax(cent_start - midpoint, midpoint - cent_end))
  )

```

```{r}
##Calculate average expression in windows 
tpm_long <- tpm_long %>%
  mutate(
    window = floor(midpoint / 500000) * 500000,  # assign gene to 300kb window
    log2TPM = log2(TPM + 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Chr, window, site, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2TPM = mean(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_genes      = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(window_center = window + 250000)  # center of each window for plotting

## Averaged across samples
tpm_long <- tpm_long %>%
  mutate(
    window  = floor(midpoint / 500000) * 500000,
    log2TPM = log2(TPM + 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Chr, window) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2TPM = mean(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_genes      = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(window_center = window + 250000)
```

```{r}
# Add centromere boundaries 
tpm_long_withc <- left_join(tpm_long,centromeres_alyrata, by=("Chr") )

ggplot(tpm_long_withc, aes(window_center,mean_log2TPM))+geom_line()+facet_wrap(~Chr)

# Get all centromere intervals
# Mark windows that overlap any centromere

# Get centromere windows
cent_windows <- centromeres_alyrata %>%
  select(Chr, centr_start, centr_end)

tpm_long_withc <- tpm_long_withc %>%
  mutate(mean_log2TPM_broken = mean_log2TPM)

# Set NA for windows overlapping any centromere
for (i in 1:nrow(cent_windows)) {
  tpm_long_withc <- tpm_long_withc %>%
    mutate(mean_log2TPM_broken = ifelse(
      Chr == cent_windows$Chr[i] &
      window_center >= cent_windows$centr_start[i]-500000 &
      window_center <= cent_windows$centr_end[i]+500000,
      NA,
      mean_log2TPM_broken
    ))
}


ggplot(tpm_long_withc, aes(window_center, mean_log2TPM_broken)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Chr, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) x / 1e6) +
  labs(x = "Genomic position (Mbp)", y = "Mean log2(TPM+1)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
